notes.title: Hardware support and bugfix update
notes.content:
This update aims to reduce the overall memory usage and improve the efficiency for Intel processors of 12th gen and later. The goal is to enable smooth gameplay on even larger maps with absolutely huge armies.

It also provides workarounds for long-standing bugs in the Intel integrated graphics drivers for these processors. If you experience random flashing colors and graphics corruption, make sure to use windowed mode and double-click anywhere in the game window to reset the graphics subsystem. If the problems appear already at game start, try changing the "GraphicsConfig" setting.

The newly added command Shift+Ctrl+Z selects all mechs of the same type(s) as those currently selected, if and only if they were built by the same factories/builders. This is an extension of the original Ctrl+Z command that will select all mechs of the same type(s).

notes.title: New years release
notes.content:
[list]
[*]Added new "Setup auto-extraction" button for factories to establish a basic Metals economy, intended for new players in particular. Hold the SHIFT key to create a more defensive extraction pattern.
[*]Made the Area extract command for factories sticky, so it will remain even after other commands have been issued. Use the button above to remove the extract commands, or press STOP (twice).
[*]Improved extraction strategy for construction mechs, with less attempts to extract unreachable resources (e.g. underwater)
[*]Fixed air transports loading/unloading process
[*]Prevent aircraft from landing on top of each other
[*]Improved behavior of hovering aircraft
[*]Resolved issue with pop-up cannons firing underground
[*]Fixed some mechs occasionally getting stuck in factories
[*]Increased bandwidth to speed up the map texture loading
[*]Improved sound quality for some in-game music
[/list]

notes.title: Map Editor release
notes.content:
Based on a library of [b]nearly 1200 satellite images[/b], the new [b]Map Editor[/b] is meant to provide an [b]almost endless variety[/b] when it comes to maps, 

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/33936393/9f02c023fa498ffde9d1403885842b0780ba1e30.png[/img]

The editor will create your favorite map based on a few simple inputs:
[list]
[*] Select a [b]thumbnail[/b] -  for large maps a high megapixel (MP) resolution is recommended
[*] Specify your [b]area[/b] of interest, which may be rotated to match the sunlight direction
[*] Choose map output [b]size[/b] - with the possibility to make a truly vast battlefield
[*] Set the [b]water[/b] level - anything between completely dry and completely submerged
[*] Optionally [b]mirror[/b] the output if it improves the overall map layout
[*] Once the result is satisfactory, press [b]Save[/b]
[/list]
Some satellite images have astounding resolutions of up to 2000 megapixels. and for this reason it can take a minute or two to make your map.

Sorry to keep you waiting, but we hope you like it!

notes.title: 250 USD AI Challenge
notes.content:
We welcome all players to participate in our [b]AI challenge[/b]!

Join any of the designated "AI Challenge" battles and defeat the AI to [b]win 250 USD[/b], or the equivalent amount in BTC.
[url=https://steamcommunity.com/profiles/76561198356213160]Contact us[/url] to claim the prize. If several players have completed the challenge when it ends (on May 30), [i]only the player with the highest score will be awarded[/i].

By participating, you agree that your battle replays may be used for promotional purposes.
By claiming the prize, you agree that a link to your Steam profile may be posted publicly to congratulate you as the winner.

Note: We [b]guarantee[/b] that this AI can be defeated. The developers behind the game can beat this AI challenge with reasonably high success rate.

Have fun!

notes.title: AI Update
notes.content: This update makes the AI [u][b]much[/b][/u] more challenging, particularly at the higher difficulty settings. Some extremely powerful mechs, battleships and economy upgrades were added in the recent release, and we want to make sure the AI is always entertaining - no matter how skilled you are. Rest assured that the boss will show absolutely no mercy...

notes.title: Version 19.05 Update
notes.content:
This update adds a selection of T3 aircraft, large mechs, battleships and amphibious craft to the Total Warfare arsenal, and it also includes several high-tech facilities with great potential to boost the economy and crush the enemy.

notes.title: AI Update
notes.content:
The latest AI will adapt better to terrain conditions and map size, to provide a real challenge both for experienced and novice players.

This release also includes some other minor bugfixes.

Enjoy!
